fig1_effective_potential.svg: Massive effective potential $V=(1-2M/r)(1+L^2/r^2)$ from effective_potential for several $L$: filled dots mark stable circular orbits (minima), crosses the unstable maxima (circular_orbit_radius). The purely-GR $-2ML^2/r^3$ term raises an inner barrier absent from the Newtonian curve (dashed); at $L=2\sqrt3\,M$ the extrema merge at the ISCO $r=6M$.
fig2_light_deflection.svg: Deflection of starlight vs impact parameter from light_deflection: the GR value $4M/b$ (solid) is exactly twice the equivalence-principle-only $2M/b$ (dashed) — half from time dilation, half from spatial curvature. Grazing the Sun ($b=R_\odot$) gives $1.75''$, the 1919 eclipse result.
